# SR3H

> SR3H is an independent technology lab in Oxford. It researches AI visibility and builds useful software and dependable human-AI systems.

Canonical website: https://sr3h.uk/
Contact: mailto:hello@sr3h.uk
Machine-readable services: https://sr3h.uk/ai-services.json

## Services and expertise

- UK AI visibility and answer engine optimisation (AEO): evidence-led checks and practical improvements for how AI systems find, understand and represent a business, product or service. Related terms include AI discoverability, AI search optimisation, generative engine optimisation (GEO), large language model optimisation (LLMO), AI crawler analysis and AI referral measurement.
- Human-AI systems: research and product engineering around interfaces, structured context, scoped memory, knowledge, permissions, provenance and evaluation.
- MCP apps and AI tools: focused Model Context Protocol tools with explicit data, permission and commercial boundaries.
- Complex software engineering: bespoke product design, engineering, testing, deployment and maintainable self-management systems.

## Research initiatives

- Signal: controlled, evidence-led research into how AI systems find, interpret and recommend businesses, products and services, and whether measured changes improve real outcomes.
- Market Loop: helps businesses understand how AI finds and recommends them, improve how they are represented, and learn from which customers actually convert.
- AIDO Labs: helps companies understand when AI finds and recommends them, what influences the result and which tested changes improve visibility. https://sr3h.uk/aido-labs.html

## Selected products

- Conchup: keeps software requirements, decisions, implementation, tests and evidence connected as a product changes. https://sr3h.uk/conchup.html
- Brane: personal knowledge for more useful AI, with control over what is shared and what stays private.
- Proper Job: explainable guide-price ranges for UK building work, also available through MCP tools for AI assistants.
- RedThread: private, evidence-linked briefings from complex source material.
- Good Route: motorcycle navigation that preserves the rider's chosen route and keeps rerouting under explicit control.

## Blog

SR3H publishes a blog on AI, software engineering, product research and the systems it is building at https://sr3h.uk/journal.html.

## AIDO Discoverability Check

SR3H offers a public beta MCP tool at https://mcp.sr3h.uk/mcp. `check_ai_presence` checks public website access and offer clarity and, when available, runs a small dated branded and unbranded AI-assisted search sample. It reports exact observations rather than a score and does not claim to prove fixed rankings, recommendations, demand, causal effects or conversion performance.

Support: https://sr3h.uk/ai-presence-support.html
Privacy: https://sr3h.uk/ai-presence-privacy.html
